claude_proposed_widenings.name: activated_ongoing_magic_item_rider
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines a bonus-action activation and dawn-reset resource cadence with a temporary on-hit rider that persists on the weapon for 1 minute or until spent. Existing magic-item families only support immediate activations, triggered reactions, summons, and passive grants.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature.
